rows.en:
(Or so I hoped, but in the end
I didn't get a single one from anyone...)
rows.notes: x3: Shirakawa, Claire and Ranka Valentine scenes (male player). Follows c21769 'I hope I get at least one from someone'.

rows.en:
U-um...!
\p-kun!!

Shirakawa...
What are you doing here?
...I had something to give you...

Something for me?
You could've just given it to me in class.

I-in class would be a little... you know?
Um, here... It's chocolate...
...P-please accept it!!

Huh? Oh, th-thanks!
I hadn't gotten any from anyone,
so I'm really happy!

I'm giving it to you to thank you for everything,
so th-there's no deeper meaning, okay?
O-okay, got it.
Um, just so you know... I made it myself...!
Huh? Homemade?

(Homemade chocolate from Shirakawa...
I'd better savor every bite.)

(It's Valentine's Day, huh...
I wonder if I'll get any...)
rows.notes: x4: Hilda, Akimizu, Nanase, Sheryl scenes (male player).

rows.en:
(Hmm, a total wipeout this year...
That's rough...)
Hey, \p, what's wrong?

Oh, Hilda-sensei...
No, it's nothing...

I see. You had a gloomy look on your face...
I'd guess you didn't get any chocolate
on Valentine's Day. Something like that?
Sensei, you don't have to put it so bluntly...

So that's what it is...
Honestly, you're young. Quit moping around.
But, Sensei...!
Here. Make do with this.
Sensei, what's this...?
I made it myself. Be grateful.

Th-thank you very much!
Did you prepare this ahead of time?

Well, every year there's someone like you,
so just in case...
You're the best, Sensei! Thank you so much!
Mm. Well then, get home safely.

(...Wait, this chocolate has my name on it...
Did Hilda-sensei make this for me
ahead of time...?)
rows.notes: The name on it shows she prepared it for him in particular, not 'just in case'.

rows.en:
(Or so I hoped, but in the end
I didn't get any from anyone...)
Heeey, \p~!!

What's up, Hoshimura?
Do you need something from me?

W-well, actually, there's something
I want to give you...
Something you want to give me?

It's Valentine's Day, right?
So, uhh, I was thinking I might go ahead
and give you some chocolate from me...
So yeah, here! It's yours!!

Huh?! Oh, th-thanks!
I hadn't gotten any from anyone,
so I'm really happy.

I made it myself, but it might not suit
your taste, \p, so don't force
yourself to eat it, okay...?

You made it yourself, Hoshimura?
Then I'll make sure to savor every bite.

Then savor it properly, and tell me
what you thought later!
S-see ya!
Yeah, thanks, Hoshimura.

(Homemade chocolate from Hoshimura...
I'd better savor every bite.)

(I wanted to give Yamashiro-sensei the
chocolate, but the timing never worked out...)

\p.
So this is where you were.
Y-Yamashiro-sensei?! What brings you here?

You've been acting all day as though you
had business with me, so I was looking for you.

Sorry you had to go to the trouble.
This is Valentine's chocolate.
Please take it, if you'd like!

I see... Thank you.
I'll be sure to enjoy it later.

Hmm, I'll need to return the favor on White Day.
I'll give it some thought.

(It was a bit late, but I'm glad I managed
to give Yamashiro-sensei the chocolate.
I wonder what he'll give me back on White Day?)

Oh, \p-kun!
You're still here. Thank goodness~
Hm? What's up, Akimizu?
Um, I wanted to give you this...
Wait, is this...?

...Um, well...
It's a thank-you for always looking out for me!
You don't have to stress the "thank-you" part...

Oh, sorry...
But it's not only that, either...

Oh, no, never mind!
Well, see you tomorrow!
Ah! Akimizu!

(That chocolate looked cute and tasted great...
It was obviously homemade, too.
That's Akimizu for you.)

Oh, Claire-senpai!
What brings you to Mihoshi?
Do you need something?
rows.notes: Claire comes from outside the school; Bisei = Mihoshi.

rows.en: ...Listen to you. You know perfectly well why...
Oh, could it be...
Yes... Homemade chocolate for Valentine's.
Please take it.

Huh? Oh, th-thank you so much!
I hadn't gotten any from anyone, so I'm really
happy! And it's homemade, too!!
rows.notes: Three Japanese lines kept as three lines, rebalanced.

rows.en:
Seeing you this happy makes it worth the effort.
Make sure you savor it, okay?
Thank you, Senpai!

(Homemade chocolate from Claire-senpai...
I'd better savor every bite.)
Hey, \p, got a minute...

Hm? Pinon-chan?
Do you need something from me?
Actually, I've got something to give you...

T-today's Valentine's Day, see.
So I figured I'd let you have some chocolate...
Here... take it!

Huh? Oh, th-thanks!
I hadn't gotten any from anyone,
so I'm really happy.

I-I made it myself, you know...
I bet it's ridiculously delicious!

Whoa, you made it yourself, Pinon-chan?
I'll make sure to savor it.

Of course you will!
Careful it's not so good it knocks you flat!
S-see ya!
Yeah, thanks, Pinon-chan.
